beats.summary: Michael invites Jerome Bettis to a party in room 308 but is told not to tell others he will be there.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You know what? I'm having a huge blowout tonight, Room 308. Hope you can come.

beats.summary: Michael asks Dwight to investigate Josh Porter for any secrets or skeletons.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I want you to dig up some dirt on Josh. Find out if there are any skeletons in his attic.
Dwight: So I called my buddy down at the station today. Had them run a background check on Josh Porter.

beats.summary: Michael expresses jealousy and rivalry towards Jim and Josh's friendship and questions Josh's qualities.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Jim and I have different definitions of friendship. I think it's talking and being friends, and Jim thinks it's moving to Connecticut and being best friends with Josh.

beats.summary: Michael promotes his party in room 308 to various people at the convention.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I have generated a lot of interest in my party this evening.

beats.summary: Michael secures a new business deal to sell HammerMill products, impressing Jan.

evidence.snippet: Jan: Well, Michael, I underestimated you.

beats.summary: Various social interactions and minor conversations occur, including Pam answering the phone and Alan discussing cartoons.
